=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Constance: "For your consideration: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Odette out."
Constance: "I have grave doubts concerning Odette. I saw them out on the Docks last night, while I was out on my duty."  [case board: #98, #99]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Veteran."  [case board: #100]
Agnes: "I'm with Constance when it comes to Odette, neighbors."  [case board: #101]
Jory: "Look, I gotta say it—I don't trust Greta! Their Dowser report doesn't fit the facts as I know them."  [case board: #32]
Greta: "You missed something, outsider: This afternoon, on the Square I sensed 1 evil among Jory, Odette, Edda, Lian."
Greta: "Constance is right on the money about Odette. My own reading pointed at them."  [case board: #102, #103]
Edda: "Constance has the right of it about Odette, friends."  [case board: #104]
Jory: "Oh! Almost forgot: From my window, I saw Greta out in the street last night."  [case board: #105]
Lian: "I back Constance's read on Odette."  [case board: #106]
